links.outcome: Public availability of training data and validation information for CE-certified AI radiology products
links.effect: Transparency scores ranged from 6.4% to 60.9%, median 29.1%; major gaps included missing documentation on training data, ethical considerations, and deployment limitations.
links.quote: Major transparency gaps included missing documentation on training data, ethical considerations, and limitations for deployment.

links.outcome: Public documentation of limitations and deployment caveats for different demographics and settings
links.effect: Deployment caveats for different demographics and medical settings were scarce; limitations for deployment often missing.
links.quote: Furthermore, deployment caveats for different demographics and medical settings were scarce.

unlisted_practices: Legally mandated public transparency requirements for medical AI products

screen.reason: Empirical audit/survey evaluating the transparency and public documentation (safety, validation, deployment caveats) of 14 CE-marked AI radiology products.
